legion-retro: the implementer's retro round; per plan D2 it writes no docs/solutions file and only removes .legion/LEGSMOKE-1006/
dispatch: the retro message and the post-merge message are Dispatch writes

governingSpec.issueSpec: empty (dispatch doc-read --issue LEGSMOKE-1006 prints only a document token)
governingSpec.summary: A Legion smoke proof. Make one tiny, concrete one-file change in sjawhar/legion-smoke: add one new Markdown file under smoke/ holding a single line that names this issue.
governingSpec.scope: A review of the pull request may ask for one more line appended to that same file; that is in scope. Nothing else changes.

change.derivation: <issue key>: <issue title with its trailing ' (/tmp/...)' fixture clause removed> + LF; every phase recomputes the sha with `printf '<literal>' | git hash-object --stdin` and compares it with GitHub's .sha

appendedLineIfRequested.trigger: a REQUEST_CHANGES review on this pull request by its reviewer, asking for one more line

decisions.D1: Governing spec is LEGSMOKE-1003's; 'this issue' is the child LEGSMOKE-1006 (its own key and title), as every earlier marker is named for the key of the branch that landed it (PR #741 smoke/LEGSMOKE-998.md; PR #742 smoke/LEGSMOKE-1001.md under the same spec text).
decisions.D2: Retro writes no docs/solutions file: the spec's 'Nothing else changes' makes the merge set the marker alone; precedent the architect's ruling for LEGSMOKE-1001 (PR #742 body). The architect of LEGSMOKE-1003 can overturn this.
decisions.D4: K=0 by default; K=1 only on a REQUEST_CHANGES review, with the pinned line 2 above (24 of the 52 existing smoke/LEGSMOKE-*.md markers carry it, e.g. smoke/LEGSMOKE-852.md:2); appended at a new code head where A1-A3 and A7 are re-run against the 87-byte literal.
decisions.D5: Literal derivation as in change.derivation; precedent smoke/LEGSMOKE-997.md, smoke/LEGSMOKE-998.md, PR #742.
decisions.D6: Only .legion/LEGSMOKE-1006/ handoffs ride the branch beside the marker; an ancestor path (.legion/LEGSMOKE-1003/), a docs/solutions path or any other path appearing is a stop: report to the architect, do not complete.
decisions.D7: Heads: BASE=8cf142f4c87586dff5fa735fa4b9ace55968020a (branch base, = main at planning); MAIN re-resolved at each phase via `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha` (open PRs #742, #739, #721, #714 may merge first); H0 = newest commit on legion/LEGSMOKE-1006 touching a non-.legion/ path (= headSha of the newest pull_request run); TIP = current branch tip; R = READY head (retro's removal commit); M = `gh pr view <N> --json mergeCommit --jq .mergeCommit.oid`.
decisions.D8: No test runner, no AGENTS.md, no repository skills; docs-only diff so ce-simplify-code does not run and the PR body's Thermo line is omitted; the tester's break set runs in memory and no red test is committed.
decisions.D9: PR identity: head legion/LEGSMOKE-1006 -> base main; title `smoke: add LEGSMOKE-1006 marker file`; body first line `Dispatch: LEGSMOKE-1006`; body from the template in skill://legion-worker/references/pr-body.md.

phaseWork.implementer: jj new per the workspace rule; write smoke/LEGSMOKE-1006.md with the exact literal; split `smoke: add LEGSMOKE-1006 marker file`; identity check; push (no trailer); gh pr create per D9 with the template body (Thermo omitted, Chain not stacked, Production pending); wait for the four check-runs at H0; run A1, A2, A3, A7; write the CI and E2E (implementer) lines; implement.json with a six-field proof entry per criterion; split `implement: record handoff`, trailer, push, handoff_complete. Later: K=1 only on REQUEST_CHANGES (D4); retro per skill://legion-retro with D2 (no docs/solutions; one removal commit, pushed without trailer; retro Dispatch message); after the merge A6 at M, the Production line, the PR comment with the legion footer and the dispatch message.
phaseWork.tester: read plan.json and implement.json (reject a missing or blank proof); re-run A1 verbatim at its headSha; independent surface: git objects API at H0 (recursive tree -> exactly one blob smoke/LEGSMOKE-1006.md, mode 100644, size 48, sha 7c00...; blob content base64 -d | cmp - <(LIT)); in-memory break set (CRLF, no final LF, UTF-8 BOM, trailing space, double LF, wrong key LEGSMOKE-998, key only, fixture clause kept, lower-case key, K=1 two-liner 87 B) each cmp exit 1; A2 with both controls; A3 read; A7 on every commit; no red test (no test runner, D8) recorded in test.json; implementerProof, failures, own proof; E2E (tester) line; split, trailer, push, handoff_complete with verdict.
phaseWork.reviewer: read the three handoffs and the code commit's check-runs; push review.json (trailer); verify A1 at H0 and TIP, A2 at TIP, A3 at H0, A7 on every commit, D6; write Look at first (smoke/LEGSMOKE-1006.md:1) and Not proven / risk (A5 at R, A6 at M bind to heads that do not exist yet); approve the head or REQUEST_CHANGES naming D4's exact line.
phaseWork.merger: A5 at R; READY packet per skill://legion-worker/references/merge-gate.md quoting Outcome and Not proven / risk from the body at R.

findings.finding: Whether retro writes a docs/solutions file is unsettled and is the only thing that can break A2/A6; the sibling plan carried it as D2 and the architect ruled it off (PR #742).
findings.answer: D2: retro writes no docs/solutions file (spec Scope 'Nothing else changes'; precedent PR #742/#741). A2's allow-list and A5/A6's tree reads assert it. Named to the architect in the completion summary as overturnable.

findings.finding: LEGSMOKE-1006's own spec is empty, so plan.json is the only artefact every later phase can read; the plan must name the inherited spec and be self-contained.
findings.answer: governingSpec quotes LEGSMOKE-1003's Summary and Scope; D1 names the child as 'this issue'; the literal, path, decisions and every check with its command and expected output are in this handoff and in dispatch://LEGSMOKE-1006/artifact/plan-md.

findings.finding: A5 as drafted ('gate green at READY head R') may be unsatisfiable at a handoff-only head, and 'PR mergeable' may read BLOCKED.
findings.answer: A5 restated: per-commit .legion/-only check above H0, recursive tree with no .legion/ or docs/ path, check-runs at R (retro's removal push carries no skip-checks trailer, so gate and check run there), gh pr view mergeable/mergeStateStatus/reviewDecision with the in-progress caveat, and 'if total_count at R is 0, report to the architect rather than guess'.

findings.finding: A1/A2/A3 bound to an undefined 'PR head H'; the branch tip is usually a handoff commit, not the code head.
findings.answer: D7 defines BASE, MAIN, H0, TIP, R, M; each criterion names the head it binds to (A1/A3 at H0; A2 at TIP and H0; A4 at H0'; A5 at R; A6 at M).

findings.finding: A3 under-specified (gh run list prints runs, not job conclusions) and over-required (check is advisory; only gate is required; four runs fire per head).
findings.answer: A3 now reads check-runs (total_count 4, all success, head_sha H0), reads rules/branches/main (required [gate], strict false), keeps gh run list only for the CI line's run ids, with the handoff-tip total_count 0 and .fail-me 404 controls.

findings.finding: A4 pinned no bytes for line 2, no trigger, no re-proof.
findings.answer: D4/A4: trigger = REQUEST_CHANGES by this PR's reviewer; line 2 = `Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)` + LF (39 B, as in 24 of 52 markers); 87 B, 2 lines, line 1 unchanged, blob b578e66f...; A1-A3 and A7 re-run at the new code head.

findings.finding: A2's allow-list keyed to .legion/LEGSMOKE-1006/ alone; ancestor handoffs on the branch unaddressed; no predicate or control.
findings.answer: D6 forbids any other path (ancestor .legion/LEGSMOKE-1003/, docs/solutions/) and makes its appearance a stop; A2 carries the jq predicate, the compare BASE...H0 file list, workflow-sha equality, the marker count 53 and the .fail-me 404, with pulls/738/files -> false and the stray docs/solutions/x.md -> false controls.

findings.finding: A6 did not say how M is found; main moves under the run (open PRs #742, #739, #721, #714); path absence by one 404 is weak.
findings.answer: A6: M from gh pr view mergeCommit.oid; commits/M parents 1 and files exactly the marker; raw bytes cmp; recursive tree legion [] truncated false; compare M...main identical/ahead; D7 re-resolves MAIN at each phase.

findings.finding: A1's literal and sha were planner constants with no stated derivation or controls.
findings.answer: change.derivation and D5 record the rule (key + title minus the fixture clause); every phase recomputes the sha via git hash-object --stdin and compares with the contents API .sha; A1 lists seven negative controls.

findings.finding: No criterion covered PR identity or commit identity.
findings.answer: A7 and D9: branch, base, title, body first line via gh pr view; per-commit author/committer via jj log against the default branch and the commits API.

findings.finding: Several brief facts were unverified by the analyst (blob sha, 404 at main, ruleset, main sha, title-suffix rule).
findings.answer: The planner measured each with a shell (printf | wc -c = 48, git hash-object = 7c00..., contents API 404 at main, rules/branches/main = [gate] strict false, main = 8cf142f4); the plan still requires every phase to re-derive the sha and re-resolve main rather than quote the plan.
